selection_rule.origin: Original frozen G financial source snapshot, source_qualified identity only. Original source lineage may inherit historic F support; no new F values, expected_finite or performance filtering is used.
selection_rule.per_issuer_selection: Unique latest publication-date original G FY25 identity; competing same-day identities remain pending, never ID-order guess.
selection_rule.native_index_requirements: Unique exact identity signatures within and across retained indexes; original full report, explicitEOF, HTTP200, pages>0, missing-native-pages0, positive native-character metadata, captured-provenance matching retained gzip path/PDF SHA/text SHA. Only compressed20 text bytes hashed; actual page/body validation deferred.

posthoc_exclusions.purpose: Explicitly prevent reuse of the three posthoc loss examples as source selection or evidence-quality criteria. No example financial values/body consumed; exclusions are not a blind OOS claim.

planned_source_schema.scope: Consolidated FY2025 annual and same-report FY2025 opening; literal priorDec31 vs fiscalJan1 role preserved. Never H1 or parent-company substitution.
planned_source_schema.arithmetic_contract: gross minus allowance equals net at printed-quantum interval; complete explicit movement table closes opening plus signed mapped movements to closing. Group/category partials cannot substitute total. No blank-zero, ambiguous sign, duplicate table or unsupported term inference.

consumer_execution_conditions.reuse_read_case: g_field_contract_next100_unit/consume_retained_sources.py::read_case+complete_index, with case.source_index_ref resolved from bindings.source_indices[source_index_binding_key]; never call oldmain/h1/economic helpers.
consumer_execution_conditions.next_checks: Fresh byte/canonical capture identity validation, retained gzip/content/page sequence binding, actual consolidated notes/table boundaries and printed field roles, then field-specific policy/scope/restatement/version/latest/later correction availability. Metadata-only full-report presence or original G snapshot is not AR/INV note/source qualification.
consumer_execution_conditions.latest_and_corrections: Known metadata candidates recorded only; titles/absence/oldG flags do not clear field scope. Unread/unknown/missing later version stays pending and no stale fallback. Prior unrelated periods cannot be permanently blocked by code-wide ancestry without role-specific evidence.
